title: Beyond the Clouds (Sha Lyndet Ki Lyoh)
cultural_context: Contemplative ballad gazing past the rainy mists of the Khasi plateau toward the eternal celestial abode.
lyrics_khasi:
Sha lyndet ki lyoh ba thaba,
Don ka khet ba phyrnai,
Hangta ka jingsuk
Kam ju wai shuh jai-jai;
Ki khmat ki peit sha suiñ,
Haba sngi ka la sep,
Ban wad ia ka shnong
Ba u Blei u la pynkhreh.

Wat suh ki eriong,
Wat hap u slap u phria,
Ka dohnud kan iaineh
Ha ka hok ka jingshisha;
Sha lyndet ki lyoh
Ngin ioh ka jingmad
Ia ka burom bathymmai
Ba u Blei u kular.
lyrics_english:
Beyond the shining white clouds,
There lies a radiant throne,
Where lasting tranquility
Never ceases or fades;
Our eyes gaze into the azure sky,
When the evening sun sinks,
Seeking that celestial homeland
Which God has prepared.

Though mountain gales may blow,
Though hail and rain may fall,
The steadfast heart shall hold
To righteousness and truth;
Beyond the swirling clouds
We shall taste the blessing
Of renewal and majesty
Promised by our God.
